# `/reports` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### GET /reports/v1/{taskResultId}/result

`getReportResultV1` — Get report result

Get the report results for a report that was run or is running. Returns empty report result in case there are no active task definitions with used in payload task definition name.

- Scopes: sp:report:manage, sp:report:read
- Parameters:
  - `taskResultId` (path, required) — Unique identifier of the task result which handled report
  - `completed` (query) — default False — state of task result to apply ordering when results are fetching from the DB
- Returns 200: reportresults

### POST /reports/v1/run

`startReportV1` — Run report

Use this API to run a report according to report input details. If non-concurrent task is already running then it returns, otherwise new task creates and returns.

- Scopes: sp:report:manage
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN
- Body (application/json): reportdetails
- Returns 200: taskresultdetails

### POST /reports/v1/{id}/cancel

`cancelReportV1` — Cancel report

Cancels a running report.

- Scopes: sp:report:manage
- Parameters:
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the running Report to cancel
- Returns 204: no body

### GET /reports/v1/{taskResultId}

`getReportV1` — Get report file

Gets a report in file format.

- Scopes: sp:report:manage, sp:report:read
- Parameters:
  - `taskResultId` (path, required) — Unique identifier of the task result which handled report
  - `fileFormat` (query, required) — one of csv, pdf — Output format of the requested report file
  - `name` (query) — preferred Report file name, by default will be used report name from task result.
  - `auditable` (query) — default False — Enables auditing for current report download. Will create an audit event and sent it to the REPORT cloud-audit kafka topic. Event will be created if there is any result present by requested…
- Returns 200: no body
